  Ground the thesis: survey learning-from-demonstration and

This track builds the intellectual foundation of the thesis. It surveys
learning from demonstration for complex, long-horizon tasks and the
current generation of vision-language-action models — NVIDIA GR00T and
the Hugging Face ecosystem (SmolVLA, π0, LeRobot) — and distills them
into a concrete problem statement: which complex tasks OARbot must
perform, what counts as success, and which baselines the learned
policies are compared against. Its outputs feed the Background chapter
directly and fix the evaluation contract that the Platform & Data and
Policy Learning initiatives build toward.
